title: Jensen Huang says he'd be "honored" to return as Nvidia CEO
source: Axios — Jensen Huang says he'd be "honored" to return as Nvidia CEO (2026-11-17)
body: Jensen Huang acknowledged in a statement to the Wall Street Journal that he'd be willing to return to Nvidia as CEO. Why it matters: A push to reinstate Huang began almost as soon as he exited the company, but Nvidia's board isn't currently considering reinstating the former CEO, according to multiple reports. What they're saying: "Since my departure, I've seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia's employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO," Huang's statement said, per WSJ. "If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO." State of play: A slew of candidates have been mentioned across multiple analyses and reports about the Nvidia successor. President Trump suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook for the role. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has urged Nvidia to look for outside candidates. Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is currently serving as the company's acting interim CEO. Editor's note: This is a breaking story and will be updated.
